description: Full Medicare Care Compare profile of one home health agency by ccn (or name and state): quality of patient care star rating with the state and national median, patient survey stars and the four survey topics with state and national percentages, would definitely recommend, 13 quality measures (timely start of care, improvement in walking, bathing, breathing and taking medicines, falls with major injury, pressure ulcers, discharge function, flu shot check) against state and national averages, discharge to community and preventable hospital readmissions and hospitalizations against the national rate, Medicare spending per episode, number of ZIP codes served, services and the Medicare.gov link. A missing value carries the CMS footnote that explains it.

ccn.description: CMS certification number (6 characters, from the search tool). Preferred when known.

city.description: City of the agency office, to narrow a name lookup.

name.description: Agency name or part of it, used when no ccn is given.

state.description: State name or two-letter code, to narrow a name lookup.

name: home_health_ratings
title: Home health agency ratings and quality measures
